purpose: Read-only inventory and byte-integrity evidence for publishing four frozen M4/M5 historical audit packages.

computation.filesystem_effects: Read source files and filesystem metadata only. Exclusive-create this JSON under /tmp. No audit package, Git index, Git ref, or source file was changed.
computation.method: For each package, parse its original inventory manifest; hash every listed file and compare SHA256 and byte count; verify the actual recursive file set equals manifest entries plus the manifest itself. Independently hash all 595 current package files, including all four original manifests. Check all UTF-8-decodable files for any line changed by Python str.rstrip(), and for a final double newline. Hash compressed/binary files as original bytes without rewriting them. For scratch, enumerate paths/stat sizes only and hash only delivery.json and task-c44-cores.bundle.
computation.scope: Only the four listed audit packages, their manifest-listed files, and scratch path/stat inventories. No broad scan of old archive contents or clone contents.
computation.new_file_creation: Path.open(mode=x) prevents overwriting prior validation output.

whitespace_check.definition: Each UTF-8-decodable file is checked for trailing whitespace by line.rstrip() != line, and blank lines at EOF by value.endswith(newline+newline). Frozen compressed/binary logs are preserved byte-for-byte and are not normalized.

historical_caveats: All four reports, status snapshots, original requests, command records, CI original ZIP bytes, raw/gzip logs, and inventories remain unchanged. Statements such as untracked, awaiting authorization, or pending describe their original recorded time and are not current workspace state.
